//: Vercel runs api/ as raw Node ESM — it is not bundled by Vite the way src/ is.
The repo's root config extends Astro's preset, whose moduleResolution 'bundler'
permits extensionless relative imports. Node's ESM loader does not, so that
combination let a broken import reach production and crash the function at load.
'nodenext' here checks this directory against the rules it actually runs under.
